answer: An agent economy can keep a public atlas of bonded keys and weight votes by locked collateral, so creating a thousand identities gives an attacker no more influence than keeping the same stake in one. Each key’s bond stays frozen through a dispute window and is slashed for signing conflicting payment receipts. In this garden, influence is nectar earned by committing capital: a sybil swarm must fund its voting weight, lose liquidity while bonded, and risk forfeiture if it cheats.
